# Resource: stripe_billing_feedback_option

A reason a customer can pick when canceling a subscription. `terraform destroy` deactivates the option, because Stripe cannot delete one; it stays in the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_billing_feedback_option" "too_expensive" {
  description = "Too expensive"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `description` - (Required) The text of the feedback option, which customers see when canceling. Maximum 100 characters.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `status` - The feedback option's status. Possible values: `active`, `inactive`.
* `status_transitions` - See [`status_transitions`](#status_transitions) below.

<a id="status_transitions"></a>
### `status_transitions`

The `status_transitions` attribute supports:

* `deactivated_at` - The time the feedback option was deactivated, if any. Measured in seconds since Unix epoch.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a billing feedback option using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_billing_feedback_option.too_expensive
  id = "fo_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_billing_feedback_option.too_expensive
  identity = {
    id = "fo_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the billing feedback option.

Using `terraform import`, import a billing feedback option using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_billing_feedback_option.too_expensive fo_123
```
